title: Expedition to Touat (1557)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Expedition to Touat (1557)", at revision 1376413417, opens: "The Expedition to Touat was a campaign led by the Saadi dynasty and commanded by the governor of Sijilmasa with the aim of establishing Saadi rule in the region, however the expedition was defeated." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q138537202, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1557 military expedition". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
